name: Student Residence Permit

qualifying_event.description: For third-country nationals admitted to an Austrian higher-education institution. Applicants apply at an Austrian embassy/consulate abroad (or, for visa-exempt entrants, directly at the Austrian residence authority).
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Letter of admission (Zulassungsbescheid) or confirmation of enrolment; proof of funds; health insurance; accommodation evidence.

requirements.blocker_text: A letter of admission from an Austrian higher-education institution (or confirmation of enrolment for in-country applicants) is required.
Proof of monthly funds for 12 months in advance: EUR 722.58/month if under 24, EUR 1,308.39/month if 24 or older (2026 figures), in an accessible account in the applicant's name.
requirements.fix_path: Deposit 12 months of the applicable monthly amount into a qualifying account.

requirements.blocker_text: Health insurance covering all risks in Austria is required (student self-insurance at EUR 78.84/month qualifies if taken out after arrival).
Proof of accommodation in Austria for a minimum of 3 months (rental agreement, student housing contract, or formal accommodation agreement).

evidence_required.document: Letter of admission or confirmation of enrolment

outcome.duration_length: 12 months, renewable with proof of academic progress (16 ECTS/8 semester hours per academic year)

sources.title: OeAD (Austria's national agency for education and internationalisation, operating under the Federal Ministry of Education) -- Residence permit for students (no mobility programme): admission proof, 2026 monthly funds figures, health insurance, accommodation, 90-180 day processing, 20 hrs/week work rights

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Austria). work_rights modeled 'restricted' per the confirmed 20 hours/week work-permit allowance without a labour-market check. family_can_join modeled false as a conservative default since no student-specific family-reunification provision was found in this pass (general family reunification in at_family_reunification.json requires a settled/working sponsor, which a student typically is not).
